title: Baked Cinnamon Sugar Churro Bites
summary: A lighter oven-baked take on Mexican-style churros: crisp-edged, tender little dough bites tossed in buttery cinnamon sugar. They are perfect for a vegetarian dessert or sweet party snack.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Lightly grease a baking tray with the vegetable oil, or grease a mini muffin tin if you want neater round bites.
Put the milk, 55 g of the butter, 20 g of the sugar and the salt in a saucepan. Heat over a medium heat until the butter melts and the mixture just comes to a simmer.

Tip in the plain flour all at once and stir vigorously with a wooden spoon for 1–2 minutes, until the dough pulls away from the sides of the pan and forms a smooth ball with a light film on the base of the pan.

Transfer the dough to a mixing bowl and let it cool for 5 minutes so the eggs do not scramble. Beat in the eggs one at a time, mixing well after each addition, then beat in the vanilla extract until the dough is smooth and glossy.
Spoon or pipe small walnut-sized mounds of dough onto the prepared tray, leaving a little space between them. Bake for 18–22 minutes, until puffed, golden and crisp at the edges.
Meanwhile, melt the remaining 30 g butter. In a separate shallow bowl, mix the remaining 80 g sugar with the cinnamon.
While the churro bites are still warm, brush them with the melted butter, then roll them in the cinnamon sugar until evenly coated. Serve warm.
